entries.text: Anthropic signed a six-year, ten billion dollar compute deal with cloud startup Volta for one hundred twenty-one megawatts of Nvidia capacity at a hydro-powered data center in Norway.
Anthropic is hiring an in-house chip design team to build custom silicon for its Claude models, co-designing hardware and models to run faster and more efficiently.
The White House met with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google to finalize a voluntary framework for reviewing the cybersecurity of frontier AI models before release.
